Big Walk Mod Menu ships these libraries unmodified.

StbImageSharp 2.30.16 (StbImageSharp.dll) - https://github.com/StbSharp/StbImageSharp
StbImageWriteSharp 1.16.7 (StbImageWriteSharp.dll) - https://github.com/StbSharp/StbImageWriteSharp
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Public domain (Unlicense) or MIT, at your choice. C# ports of Sean Barrett's stb_image and
stb_image_write.

Not shipped, downloaded by the installer from its official site: BepInEx 6 (LGPL-2.1),
https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.14 and the BlazeFace short-range model - https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Not shipped with the mod: the webcam page loads them in your browser from cdn.jsdelivr.net and
storage.googleapis.com when face tracking is used. Apache License 2.0. Copyright The MediaPipe Authors.
